content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to the use of open-source tools and decentralized payment systems to create online stores that are not reliant on traditional payment gateways. This approach matters because it empowers digital creators to take control of their businesses, avoiding the risks of account suspensions and payment freezes. By utilizing crypto payments, creators can receive funds directly, without intermediaries, and maintain ownership of their customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure typically involves the use of static site generators like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, paired with backend logic provided by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For payment processing, solutions like NOWPayments enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with support for over 300 cryptocurrencies. This setup allows for seamless integration of crypto payments, instant product delivery, and secure order storage.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or restricted, such as Kenya, Nigeria, and Ghana. These creators often face significant challenges in receiving payments for their digital products, including ebooks, courses, and software. By providing a decentralized and open-source solution, sovereign commerce infrastructure bridges this gap, enabling creators to reach a global audience and monetize their products effectively.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include hosting solutions, backend logic, payment processing, and order storage. Each of these components is carefully selected to ensure seamless integration, security, and scalability. For instance, GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages provide reliable hosting, while Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle backend logic. NOWPayments facilitates crypto payments, and Supabase or Google Sheets store orders securely.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can start by selecting the necessary components and integrating them into their online store. This may involve setting up a GitHub Pages site, configuring Cloudflare Workers, and connecting NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. With the right guidance and support, creators can quickly establish a fully functional online store, complete with automatic payment verification and instant product delivery.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Crypto payments enable instant and secure transactions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
